Title inferred from National Diet Library OPAC, March, 27, 2020. Created original map in Genroku 9 i.e. 1696 Oriented with north to the right. Wood block print. LC copy annotated in black ink for points of interest and historic events. Relief shown pictorially. Cadastral map showing landowners. Japanese. Includes distance chart and list of daily events in Edo for 1860. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
